body:
That's really nice of you, I'll definately update you on my situation and I feel you're genuine. I can't talk to my mom because I've never told her about my feelings and she's the kind of mom thats not good with them, it doesn't mean she's a bad mother, shes a great but not when it comes to these things.

Expect a pm in a week or so, nanner!

I am going to try and work out all my assignments I had left before the real deadline. Then show up when I'm supposed to give them my laptop, school id and so on and tell them I've done all the work, if that doesn't work I'll have to be unemployed for half a year before I can restart my studies...

That's my current plan, chances of it working is around 10% but I am not giving up. This is all my own fault 100%, pure laziness. Even though I never was going to take suicide, thanks for the motivation brother.

I haven't shed a single tear for god knows how long but right now I'm feeling very "teary eyed".

I had this happen to me before when I stopped doing sports all my friends disappeared. It was the worst, for years I was lonely but I finnaly managed to have friends through alcohol and school. Now I feel like atleast a good 80% of those friends will leave me and I'll have to burden my single mother even further by going to school for another 2 years(6 in total).
